tools.name: axes_explain_question
tools.description: Read the official explanation and glossary for a statement in this quiz. Use it when the user asks what agreeing or disagreeing means.

tools.name: axes_record_answers
tools.description: Record chosen answers and return a compact client-held resume token, progress count and next statement. Call after each answer or batch and before pausing. tools.name: axes_explain_result
tools.description: Explain a compatible 12 Axes result link from any domain. Returns both poles of every axis, a 12axes.cc result link, and matches recalculated with our catalogue. For an image, first decode its QR with axes_read_result_qr.

tools.name: axes_compare_results
tools.description: Compare two compatible 12 Axes result links from any domain using the website compatibility formula. For images, first decode each QR with axes_read_result_qr. Returns the largest axis gaps first and a comparison link.

tools.name: axes_get_report

tools.name: axes_lookup_profile

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: axes_read_result_qr · Private data: axes_get_questions, axes_record_answers · Public sink: axes_score_answers, axes_generate_share_card.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: axes_read_result_qr · Private data: axes_get_questions, axes_record_answers · Public sink: axes_score_answers, axes_generate_share_card

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
